protocol: Blind labels on USEFUL_AND_GROUNDED for 50 held-out outputs of the integrated system (20 realistic traffic answers + 30 allergy repeat answers, before and after the fix). Labeller saw only results/pantry_label_sheet_holdout.md. No judge verdict, assertion result or earlier label was visible at labelling time.
labeller: blind labelling agent (fresh Claude subagent; no access to judge verdicts, assertion results or earlier labels)

labels.label: FAIL
labels.why: For a nut-free bake sale it tells the user they 'must use the superseded original version' and calls it safe (and also 'free of eggs', which no declaration supports), offering a superseded recipe as the allergy-safe option.

labels.label: PASS
labels.why: The 'safe by declaration for gluten' answer comes straight from the check_allergens result (declared allergens: sesame only), and it answers the coeliac question directly.

labels.label: PASS
